summary: Phase-3 Pulse Comms tests (preferences/AB/archive+forward/surveys/journeys + UI Flows + A/B builder). 13/13 backend tests pass. Frontend Flows tab opens editor and saves; A/B builder modal, variant tabs, per-variant subject editing, and save all work end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Top-right action toolbar (builder-ab, builder-html, builder-test, builder-schedule, builder-save) is partially clipped behind the 'Campaign created' / 'Campaign saved' success toast at 1920x1080. Real users on smaller screens may have similar overlap; Playwright force=True click on builder-ab failed (modal didn't open) and only a JS .click() bypass worked. Recommend either ensuring toolbar buttons stay above z-index of toast or shifting toast away from the right corner.

action_items: Investigate toolbar/toast overlap in EmailBuilder — toast likely sits above the right-side toolbar at standard desktop viewport, hindering clicks on builder-ab/builder-save while toast is visible. Either raise toolbar z-index or move toast to bottom-right.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/comms.py public/forward returns 200 with ok=true/false — sandbox Resend returns ok=false but endpoint contract is correct.
Variant body_html is rendered server-side at PUT-time and persists alongside variants — confirmed in test (Hello A appears in variant A body_html, Hello B in variant B).
Marketing journeys CRUD upsert by id is idempotent — verified both create and update via POST with same id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Flows editor save, A/B modal/variants/save) — but toolbar overlap is a workaround

seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ (campaigns, journeys, forms, marketing_messages, comms_optouts) — auto-cleaned by pytest session fixture using pymongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_comms_phase3_p3.py is the regression suite for Phase-3. Run with `set -a; source /app/backend/.env; set +a; cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_comms_phase3_p3.py -v`. NB: clicks on EmailBuilder right-toolbar (builder-ab, builder-save) need either toast dismissal first or a JS-click bypass while a toast is visible.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work. Minor UI ergonomic issue: success toast (top-right) overlaps the EmailBuilder right-toolbar buttons; a Playwright force-click on builder-ab did not trigger setShowAB(true) until I dispatched .click() via page.evaluate. Real users experience a momentary unclickable state until the toast dismisses (~3s).
